scope.description: A context-specific abstract-painting direction built from distinct groups of brushstrokes that counterpose in direction, scale, and paint thickness. Color weight and stroke density create movement across a broad visible ground without requiring a literal landscape, horizon, or focal object. It controls paint relationships, not subject matter.
limitations: Apply only to a user-requested abstract or painterly composition with visible brushwork.
Preserve any requested subject, color roles, object count, and framing.
Do not introduce a horizon, trees, flowers, water, or landscape objects unless requested.
Avoid copying a named canvas, panel arrangement, or identifiable stroke pattern.

rules.applies_when: The user requests a painterly abstract field or a subject treated through visible brush groups.
rules.instruction: Organize marks into a few distinct families with different directions, such as horizontal sweeps answered by diagonal or vertical strokes; vary scale and pressure within each family and preserve readable intervals between groups.
rules.observable: The image has several directional brush clusters with a legible counter-rhythm rather than one repeated all-over texture.
rules.reject_when: Every mark points the same way, clusters dissolve into a uniform web, or a new focal subject appears.
rules.avoid: uniform splatter, repetitive parallel striping, and all-over webbing

rules.applies_when: The requested treatment relies on color and visible oil-paint handling.
rules.instruction: Vary paint thickness and opacity across the color groups; reserve a few dense, opaque strokes as anchors, balance them with thinner veils or scumbled passages, and keep each hue attached to its own stroke form.
rules.observable: Color has different weights and surface depths while remaining tied to discrete marks rather than a global filter.
rules.reject_when: All paint looks equally thick, translucent passages turn into a full-image wash, or color loses its local structure.
rules.avoid: global color overlays, uniform impasto, and digital gradients

rules.applies_when: The user requests an open abstract field or permits visible unpainted ground.
rules.instruction: Preserve broad, intentional ground passages between stroke groups; let their shape and width create pauses and counterbalance the denser color areas.
rules.observable: Ground remains an active compositional element rather than a thin border or a fully covered background.
rules.reject_when: Marks fill the surface uniformly or ground is inserted only as empty margins.
rules.avoid: edge-to-edge texture, decorative blank border, and erased subject structure

joint_checks.observable: Stroke families counterpose; paint thickness varies; ground creates pauses; no fixed landscape or all-over web is added.
